options.approach: Audit the precise monotone-completeness theorem and distinguish completeness of the projection lattice from completeness in the self-adjoint order. Withdraw the empty-set conclusion if no applicable theorem supports that distinction.

options.approach: Reduce exhaustion to a projection-packing statement by taking spectral cuts of the increments. Investigate whether infinitely many projections of uniformly positive quasitrace can have uniformly bounded positive partial sums in a finite AW*-factor.
